acceptance.beforeAdmission: At the actual shutdown boundary, require the protected command to be rejected by ast_shutting_down before module teardown.
acceptance.afterAdmission: Require modules_shutdown to retain a leased target, release the dispatch, and complete a test-only retry before process exit.
limitations: The before-admission schedule proves the global shutdown gate, not cli_closing-specific denial.
The supervisor protocol unit tests are offline and are not native Asterisk evidence.
Patch source application, compilation, profile transparency, and native execution remain unverified.
